definition: depth(t) = y_deepest(frame 0) - y_deepest(frame t), y_deepest = most negative zero crossing of the SDF over all columns, linearly interpolated between vertically adjacent samples (sub-cell; row grid is 0.1575 um)
why_derived_not_read: the stored target_depth is the depth REQUESTED of choose_dt, not achieved, and it is NaN for every test_crossed trajectory

vs_stored_target_depth.reading: achieved should track requested but sit BELOW it: choose_dt sizes dt from the rate on the initial flat geometry, and the rate falls as the trench deepens, so the etch under-delivers.
